topics.name: axes
topics.description: The Gamepad's sticks. The chosen axis is a speed: hold it and the joint turns, let go and it stops.

topics.name: joint_state
topics.description: The joint's real position: wire the joint's Joint Controller state here, so each push starts from where the joint is.

topics.name: trajectory
topics.description: The joint's target position, sent only while the stick is pushed. Wire into the joint's Joint Controller trajectory.

joint_id.label: Joint
joint_id.description: The joint the stick moves (a pan, a tilt, a turret, a lift). The trajectory is addressed to it.

axis.label: Stick Axis
axis.description: Which stick axis moves the joint. Right and up are positive.

speed.label: Speed
speed.description: How fast the joint moves at full stick.

invert.label: Invert
invert.description: Reverse the direction, for a joint whose positive rotation goes the other way from the stick.

min_position.label: Min. Position
min_position.description: The joint's lower travel limit; the target never goes past it.

max_position.label: Max. Position
max_position.description: The joint's upper travel limit; the target never goes past it.

max_lead.label: Max. Lead
max_lead.description: How far the target may run ahead of the joint's real position, so a joint that lags stops soon after the stick is released. 0 = no limit.

rate_hz.label: Integration Rate
rate_hz.description: How often the stick is integrated into a new target.
